from manim import *
import numpy as np

# === TeachingScene Base Class ===
class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

# === Section 2 Scene ===
class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Storyboard data
        title = "Prerequisite: The Language of Waves"
        lines = [
            "Light waves have both amplitude and phase properties.",
            "Interference happens when two light waves overlap.",
            "Aligned peaks create brightness, while opposing peaks cancel out."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)
        
        # Define boundaries for wave from the grid
        tl_pos = self.grid["B1"]
        br_pos = self.grid["E6"]
        width = br_pos[0] - tl_pos[0]
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        
        # Trackers for animation control
        phase_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        amp_tracker = ValueTracker(0.7)
        
        def get_wave_points(phase, amp):
            points = []
            num_points = 100
            for i in range(num_points):
                pct = i / (num_points - 1)
                x = tl_pos[0] + pct * width
                # Model wave with 2 full cycles
                y = center_y + amp * np.sin(4 * np.pi * pct - phase)
                points.append([x, y, 0])
            return points

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # A white sine wave #FFFFFF oscillates horizontally.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        
        wave1 = VMobject(color=WHITE)
        wave1.set_points_as_corners(get_wave_points(0, 0.7))
        
        def wave1_updater(mob):
            mob.set_points_as_corners(get_wave_points(phase_tracker.get_value(), amp_tracker.get_value()))
            
        wave1.add_updater(wave1_updater)
        self.add(wave1)
        
        # Oscillation loop
        self.play(phase_tracker.animate.set_value(2 * PI), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # The peak of the wave flashes yellow #FFFF00 and the trough flashes magenta #FF00FF.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].set_color(GRAY),
            self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        peak_dot = Dot(color=YELLOW)
        trough_dot = Dot(color=MAGENTA)
        
        def dots_updater(group):
            pts = wave1.get_points()
            if pts is not None and len(pts) > 0:
                # Find current peak and trough indices based on Y values
                y_vals = pts[:, 1]
                p_idx = np.argmax(y_vals)
                t_idx = np.argmin(y_vals)
                group[0].move_to(pts[p_idx])
                group[1].move_to(pts[t_idx])
            
        dots = VGroup(peak_dot, trough_dot)
        dots.add_updater(dots_updater)
        self.add(dots)
        
        # Highlight properties
        self.play(
            Flash(peak_dot, color="#FFFF00", flash_radius=0.3),
            Flash(trough_dot, color="#FF00FF", flash_radius=0.3),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Show dots moving with the wave
        self.play(phase_tracker.animate.set_value(4 * PI), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        
        # Clean up tracking dots before interference
        dots.remove_updater(dots_updater)
        self.remove(dots)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Two waves align their peaks, merging into a single wave with double amplitude in cyan #00FFFF.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY),
            self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        # Second wave starts out of phase
        phase_tracker2 = ValueTracker(phase_tracker.get_value() + PI)
        wave2 = VMobject(color=WHITE, stroke_opacity=0.5)
        
        def wave2_updater(mob):
            mob.set_points_as_corners(get_wave_points(phase_tracker2.get_value(), amp_tracker.get_value()))
            
        wave2.add_updater(wave2_updater)
        self.add(wave2)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Transition to constructive interference (Align phases)
        self.play(
            phase_tracker2.animate.set_value(phase_tracker.get_value()),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Final merge: increase amplitude and color change to Cyan
        wave2.clear_updaters()
        self.play(
            amp_tracker.animate.set_value(1.4),
            wave1.animate.set_color("#00FFFF"),
            FadeOut(wave2),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Continue oscillation of the resulting constructive wave
        self.play(phase_tracker.animate.set_value(6 * PI), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(2)
